title: Claude on Foundry — AI Gateway & Claude Code usage
description: Token usage per user/model from the APIM AI Gateway, gateway health from APIM resource logs, and Claude Code client telemetry from OTLP metrics. Part of the claude-on-foundry plugin.

list.name: prom_ds
list.label: Prometheus (Azure Monitor workspace)
list.description: Azure Monitor workspace linked to the Application Insights component (OTLP metrics).

list.name: apim
list.label: API Management
list.description: AI Gateway instance. Its resource logs must go to a Log Analytics workspace (resource-specific tables).

list.name: user
list.label: User

azureLogAnalytics.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp > ago(90d)
| where name == "Total Tokens"
| distinct tostring(customDimensions.UserName)

list.description: Filters the AI Gateway token panels. Values come from the UserName dimension of the token metric.

list.name: price_factor
list.label: Price multiplier
list.description: Applied to list prices for gateway cost estimates, e.g. 0.85 for a 15% negotiated discount.

list.name: price_table
list.label: Price table
list.description: USD per million tokens by model family: [input, output, cache read, cache write 5m]. Edit in Dashboard settings > Variables to add models or change prices.

list.name: client
list.label: Claude client
list.description: Filters the Claude Code telemetry panels by OTel service.name.

panels.title: AI Gateway — token usage (all clients, source: APIM llm-emit-token-metric)
Estimated cost
panels.description: Gateway tokens × the price_table dashboard variable × the price multiplier. List prices; cache writes priced at the 5-minute rate. Your Foundry invoice is authoritative.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let P = parse_json('${price_table:raw}');
let F = todouble('${price_factor}');
customMetrics
| where name in ("Prompt Tokens", "Completion Tokens", "Prompt Cached Tokens", "Cache Creation Tokens")
| where '__all__' in (${user:singlequote}) or tostring(customDimensions.UserName) in (${user:singlequote})
| extend model = tostring(customDimensions.model), user = tostring(customDimensions.UserName)
| extend p = P[extract(@"claude-(?:opus|sonnet|haiku|fable|mythos)-\d+(?:-\d\b)?", 0, model)]
| extend cost = valueSum / 1e6 * F * todouble(case(name == "Prompt Tokens", p[0], name == "Completion Tokens", p[1],
                                                  name == "Prompt Cached Tokens", p[2], p[3]))
| summarize cost = sum(cost) by bin(timestamp, $__interval)
| order by timestamp asc

panels.title: Billable tokens
panels.description: Input + output + cache read + cache write. APIM's own 'Total Tokens' metric excludes cache tokens, which are usually the largest share of Claude traffic.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
customMetrics
| where name in ("Prompt Tokens", "Completion Tokens", "Prompt Cached Tokens", "Cache Creation Tokens")
| where '__all__' in (${user:singlequote}) or tostring(customDimensions.UserName) in (${user:singlequote})
| summarize tokens = sum(valueSum) by bin(timestamp, $__interval)
| order by timestamp asc

customMetrics
| where name in ("Prompt Tokens")
| where '__all__' in (${user:singlequote}) or tostring(customDimensions.UserName) in (${user:singlequote})
| summarize tokens = sum(valueSum) by bin(timestamp, $__interval)
| order by timestamp asc

customMetrics
| where name in ("Completion Tokens")
| where '__all__' in (${user:singlequote}) or tostring(customDimensions.UserName) in (${user:singlequote})
| summarize tokens = sum(valueSum) by bin(timestamp, $__interval)
| order by timestamp asc

customMetrics
| where name in ("Prompt Cached Tokens")
| where '__all__' in (${user:singlequote}) or tostring(customDimensions.UserName) in (${user:singlequote})
| summarize tokens = sum(valueSum) by bin(timestamp, $__interval)
| order by timestamp asc

panels.title: Cache write
panels.description: 'Cache Creation Tokens' is only emitted by recent APIM gateway versions; older periods read low.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
customMetrics
| where name in ("Cache Creation Tokens")
| where '__all__' in (${user:singlequote}) or tostring(customDimensions.UserName) in (${user:singlequote})
| summarize tokens = sum(valueSum) by bin(timestamp, $__interval)
| order by timestamp asc

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Cache read ÷ (input + cache read + cache write).

azureLogAnalytics.query:
customMetrics
| where name in ("Prompt Tokens", "Completion Tokens", "Prompt Cached Tokens", "Cache Creation Tokens") and name != "Completion Tokens"
| where '__all__' in (${user:singlequote}) or tostring(customDimensions.UserName) in (${user:singlequote})
| summarize cached = sumif(valueSum, name == "Prompt Cached Tokens"), all = sum(valueSum)
| project ratio = iff(all == 0, real(null), cached / all)

panels.title: Active users
panels.description: Distinct Entra ID 'sub' claims.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "Total Tokens"
| where '__all__' in (${user:singlequote}) or tostring(customDimensions.UserName) in (${user:singlequote})
| summarize users = dcount(tostring(customDimensions.Subject))

customMetrics
| where name in ("Prompt Tokens", "Completion Tokens", "Prompt Cached Tokens", "Cache Creation Tokens")
| where '__all__' in (${user:singlequote}) or tostring(customDimensions.UserName) in (${user:singlequote})
| extend type = case(name == "Prompt Tokens", "input", name == "Completion Tokens", "output",
                     name == "Prompt Cached Tokens", "cache read", "cache write")
| summarize tokens = sum(valueSum) by bin(timestamp, $__interval), type
| order by timestamp asc

panels.title: Estimated cost by user (top 10)
panels.description: Gateway tokens × the price_table dashboard variable × the price multiplier. List prices; cache writes priced at the 5-minute rate. Your Foundry invoice is authoritative.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let P = parse_json('${price_table:raw}');
let F = todouble('${price_factor}');
let base = customMetrics
| where name in ("Prompt Tokens", "Completion Tokens", "Prompt Cached Tokens", "Cache Creation Tokens")
| where '__all__' in (${user:singlequote}) or tostring(customDimensions.UserName) in (${user:singlequote})
| extend model = tostring(customDimensions.model), user = tostring(customDimensions.UserName)
| extend p = P[extract(@"claude-(?:opus|sonnet|haiku|fable|mythos)-\d+(?:-\d\b)?", 0, model)]
| extend cost = valueSum / 1e6 * F * todouble(case(name == "Prompt Tokens", p[0], name == "Completion Tokens", p[1],
                                                  name == "Prompt Cached Tokens", p[2], p[3]));
let top = base | summarize c = sum(cost) by user | top 10 by c | project user;
base
| where user in (top)
| summarize cost = sum(cost) by bin(timestamp, $__interval), user
| order by timestamp asc

panels.title: Usage by user
panels.description: Gateway tokens × the price_table dashboard variable × the price multiplier. List prices; cache writes priced at the 5-minute rate. Your Foundry invoice is authoritative.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let P = parse_json('${price_table:raw}');
let F = todouble('${price_factor}');
let costs = customMetrics
| where name in ("Prompt Tokens", "Completion Tokens", "Prompt Cached Tokens", "Cache Creation Tokens")
| where '__all__' in (${user:singlequote}) or tostring(customDimensions.UserName) in (${user:singlequote})
| extend model = tostring(customDimensions.model), user = tostring(customDimensions.UserName)
| extend p = P[extract(@"claude-(?:opus|sonnet|haiku|fable|mythos)-\d+(?:-\d\b)?", 0, model)]
| extend cost = valueSum / 1e6 * F * todouble(case(name == "Prompt Tokens", p[0], name == "Completion Tokens", p[1],
                                                  name == "Prompt Cached Tokens", p[2], p[3]))
| summarize ['Est. cost'] = sum(cost) by User = user;
customMetrics
| where name in ("Prompt Tokens", "Completion Tokens", "Prompt Cached Tokens", "Cache Creation Tokens") or name == "Total Tokens"
| where '__all__' in (${user:singlequote}) or tostring(customDimensions.UserName) in (${user:singlequote})
| extend user = tostring(customDimensions.UserName), quota = tolong(customDimensions.quota)
| summarize
    Input = sumif(valueSum, name == "Prompt Tokens"),
    Output = sumif(valueSum, name == "Completion Tokens"),
    ['Cache read'] = sumif(valueSum, name == "Prompt Cached Tokens"),
    ['Cache write'] = sumif(valueSum, name == "Cache Creation Tokens"),
    Requests = sumif(valueCount, name == "Total Tokens"),
    ['Daily quota'] = max(quota),
    ['Last seen'] = max(timestamp)
    by User = user
| extend Billable = Input + Output + ['Cache read'] + ['Cache write']
| join kind=leftouter costs on User
| project User, ['Est. cost'], Billable, Input, Output, ['Cache read'], ['Cache write'], Requests, ['Daily quota'],
          ['Last seen']
| order by ['Est. cost'] desc

panels.title: Today's quota consumption (UTC day)
panels.description: Input + output against the per-tier daily token-quota. Ignores the dashboard time range. Approximation of the llm-token-limit counter, which is keyed on the token 'sub' claim. Cost today includes cache tokens, which the quota does not count.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let P = parse_json('${price_table:raw}');
let F = todouble('${price_factor}');
let costs = customMetrics
| where name in ("Prompt Tokens", "Completion Tokens", "Prompt Cached Tokens", "Cache Creation Tokens")
| where timestamp >= startofday(now())
| where '__all__' in (${user:singlequote}) or tostring(customDimensions.UserName) in (${user:singlequote})
| extend model = tostring(customDimensions.model), user = tostring(customDimensions.UserName)
| extend p = P[extract(@"claude-(?:opus|sonnet|haiku|fable|mythos)-\d+(?:-\d\b)?", 0, model)]
| extend cost = valueSum / 1e6 * F * todouble(case(name == "Prompt Tokens", p[0], name == "Completion Tokens", p[1],
                                                  name == "Prompt Cached Tokens", p[2], p[3]))
| summarize ['Cost today'] = sum(cost) by User = user;
customMetrics
| where timestamp >= startofday(now())
| where name == "Total Tokens"
| where '__all__' in (${user:singlequote}) or tostring(customDimensions.UserName) in (${user:singlequote})
| summarize Used = sum(valueSum), Quota = max(tolong(customDimensions.quota)) by User = tostring(customDimensions.UserName)
| extend ['% of quota'] = iff(Quota > 0, todouble(Used) / Quota, real(null))
| join kind=leftouter costs on User
| project User, Used, Quota, ['% of quota'], ['Cost today']
| order by ['% of quota'] desc

customMetrics
| where name in ("Prompt Tokens", "Completion Tokens", "Prompt Cached Tokens", "Cache Creation Tokens")
| where '__all__' in (${user:singlequote}) or tostring(customDimensions.UserName) in (${user:singlequote})
| summarize tokens = sum(valueSum) by bin(timestamp, $__interval), model = tostring(customDimensions.model)
| order by timestamp asc

panels.title: Usage by API and model
panels.description: Gateway tokens × the price_table dashboard variable × the price multiplier. List prices; cache writes priced at the 5-minute rate. Your Foundry invoice is authoritative.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let P = parse_json('${price_table:raw}');
let F = todouble('${price_factor}');
customMetrics
| where name in ("Prompt Tokens", "Completion Tokens", "Prompt Cached Tokens", "Cache Creation Tokens")
| where '__all__' in (${user:singlequote}) or tostring(customDimensions.UserName) in (${user:singlequote})
| extend model = tostring(customDimensions.model), user = tostring(customDimensions.UserName)
| extend p = P[extract(@"claude-(?:opus|sonnet|haiku|fable|mythos)-\d+(?:-\d\b)?", 0, model)]
| extend cost = valueSum / 1e6 * F * todouble(case(name == "Prompt Tokens", p[0], name == "Completion Tokens", p[1],
                                                  name == "Prompt Cached Tokens", p[2], p[3]))
| summarize
    ['Est. cost'] = sum(cost),
    Billable = sum(valueSum),
    Input = sumif(valueSum, name == "Prompt Tokens"),
    Output = sumif(valueSum, name == "Completion Tokens"),
    ['Cache read'] = sumif(valueSum, name == "Prompt Cached Tokens"),
    Users = dcount(tostring(customDimensions.Subject)),
    priced = countif(isnotnull(p))
    by ['API ID'] = tostring(customDimensions['API ID']), Model = model,
       Environment = tostring(customDimensions.Environment)
| extend Price = iff(priced > 0, "found", "missing — add to price_table")
| project-away priced
| order by Billable desc

panels.title: AI Gateway — requests, errors and latency (source: APIM resource logs)

azureLogAnalytics.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where isnotempty(ApiId) and Url contains "/v1/messages"
| summarize requests = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Success rate
panels.description: Amber below 99%, red below 95%.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where isnotempty(ApiId) and Url contains "/v1/messages"
| summarize ok = countif(ResponseCode between (200 .. 299)), n = count()
| project rate = iff(n == 0, real(null), todouble(ok) / n)

panels.title: Rejected by gateway
panels.description: 401/403/429 produced by APIM itself: invalid token, no quota tier, or daily token quota exhausted. Not coloured: this is the quota policy working as designed.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where isnotempty(ApiId) and Url contains "/v1/messages"
| where ResponseCode in (401, 403, 429) and isnull(BackendResponseCode)
| summarize n = count()

panels.title: Throttled by Foundry (429)
panels.description: Backend capacity (TPM/RPM) on the Foundry deployment, not user quota. Amber from 1, red from 50.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where isnotempty(ApiId) and Url contains "/v1/messages"
| where BackendResponseCode == 429
| summarize n = count()

panels.title: Backend / connection errors
panels.description: 5xx and dropped connections (ResponseCode 0). Amber from 1, red from 10.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where isnotempty(ApiId) and Url contains "/v1/messages"
| where ResponseCode >= 500 or ResponseCode == 0
| summarize n = count()

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: Streaming responses: time until the last byte, not time to first token.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where isnotempty(ApiId) and Url contains "/v1/messages"
| where ResponseCode between (200 .. 299)
| summarize p95 = percentile(TotalTime, 95)

panels.title: Unmatched requests (404)
panels.description: Claude or telemetry requests that matched no API — usually a wrong base URL or a :443 suffix on a client endpoint. Amber from 1.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where isempty(ApiId)
| where Url contains "/v1/messages" or Url contains "/otlp"
| summarize n = count()

panels.title: Telemetry ingestion success
panels.description: OTLP API that forwards Claude Code telemetry to Azure Monitor. Amber below 99%, red below 95%.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where isnotempty(ApiId) and Url matches regex @"/otlp/v1/(traces|metrics|logs)"
| summarize ok = countif(ResponseCode between (200 .. 299)), n = count()
| project rate = iff(n == 0, real(null), todouble(ok) / n)

ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where isnotempty(ApiId) and Url contains "/v1/messages"
| extend status = case(ResponseCode between (200 .. 299), "2xx",
                       BackendResponseCode == 429, "429 Foundry",
                       ResponseCode in (401, 403, 429) and isnull(BackendResponseCode), strcat(ResponseCode, " gateway"),
                       ResponseCode == 0, "connection dropped",
                       strcat(ResponseCode))
| summarize requests = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval), status
| order by TimeGenerated asc

ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where isnotempty(ApiId) and Url contains "/v1/messages"
| where ResponseCode between (200 .. 299)
| summarize ['p50 total'] = percentile(TotalTime, 50), ['p95 total'] = percentile(TotalTime, 95),
            ['p95 backend'] = percentile(BackendTime, 95) by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Requests by API and APIM subscription
panels.description: API = first path segment of the gateway URL.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where Url contains "/v1/messages" or Url contains "/otlp"
| extend Api = tostring(split(parse_url(Url).Path, "/")[1])
| summarize Requests = count(),
            ['2xx'] = countif(ResponseCode between (200 .. 299)),
            ['Gateway 4xx'] = countif(ResponseCode between (400 .. 499) and isnull(BackendResponseCode)),
            ['Foundry 429'] = countif(BackendResponseCode == 429),
            ['5xx / dropped'] = countif(ResponseCode >= 500 or ResponseCode == 0),
            ['Last seen'] = max(TimeGenerated)
    by Api, ['APIM subscription'] = iff(isempty(ApimSubscriptionId), "(Entra ID / none)", ApimSubscriptionId)
| order by Requests desc

ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where Url contains "/v1/messages" or Url contains "/otlp"
| where not(ResponseCode between (200 .. 399))
| extend Api = tostring(split(parse_url(Url).Path, "/")[1])
| summarize Count = count(), ['Last seen'] = max(TimeGenerated)
    by Api, Status = ResponseCode, ['Backend status'] = BackendResponseCode,
       Source = LastErrorSource, Reason = LastErrorReason, Message = substring(LastErrorMessage, 0, 160)
| order by Count desc
